question:
Ten persons are sitting in two parallel rows containing five persons each, such that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons.

Line 1: Five men (A-E) are seated and all of them are facing South.

Line 2: Five women (M-Q) are seated and all of them are facing North.

Based on the arrangement, answer the question:

D is opposite to M.

M is at one of the extreme ends of Line 2.

O is at the center position of Line 2.

Who is second to the right of M in Line 2 (facing North)?
